rationale: Pins the wgpu-native runtime archive by SHA-256 (manifest artifacts) in setup.sh and at configure (new PulpWgpuNative.cmake, called from PulpFetchContent/PulpDependencies; PulpWgpuUniversal reads the same pins) and widens tools/deps/audit.py's fetch scan. The same v24.0.3.1 runtime is selected and linked as before; the change only refuses bytes that do not match the pinned digests. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
